title: Deepa v. State of Karnataka (Motor Accident)
text: The claimant, Deepa, filed a motor accident claim petition seeking compensation for injuries sustained in a road accident caused by a rash and negligent driver. The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal awarded Rs 8,00,000. This appeal challenges the quantum. Medical evidence shows permanent disability of 35%. The court applies the structured formula for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act including loss of income, medical expenses, and pain and suffering. Enhanced compensation of Rs 15,00,000 is awarded. The insurance company is directed to pay the enhanced amount. The claimant is entitled to full compensation.
